title: FightCamp App Update: Introducing Music Stations
summary: Whether you like Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop or EDM, these curated playlists were hand-picked to motivate you to give 110%.
body_markdown:
### Workout to a Brand New Sound


Elevate your workout experience with the new music station feature. You can now choose between a curated selection of EDM, Pop, Rock and Hip-Hop before starting your workout.


### Let us Know What you Think!


What do you think of the new music stations? Share your feedback and product requests with the rest of the community.


[Join the FightCamp Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/542530602799015/)


on Facebook, and you'll get to chat with other FightCamp users and FightCamp trainers.
